id: Feature ID deterministic within a release. Join via routeId and schoolId to the original route.
part: Zero-based LineString part in the parent geometry.
routeId: Original full UDOT route feature ID.
stress: lower, higher or unassessed; highest assessed direction.
lengthMeters: Length of this segment in projected meters.
forward: Native score along route-coordinate order, null if unknown or unavailable.
reverse: Native score in reverse route-coordinate order, null if unknown or unavailable.
forwardBearing: Approximate compass heading in forward travel.
reverseBearing: Approximate compass heading in reverse travel.
source: Local Brokenspoke, Utah Bikeways, UDOT plan crosswalk, or null.
sourceDate: OSM replication date, Utah edit date or plan point retrieval date.
street: Source name of the traveled street, when known.
crossStreet: Other named arms of this node, when known.
matchStatus: matched, ambiguous, unmatched, connected-through or plan-crosswalk.
directionBasis: route-coordinate-order for BNA, undirected for Utah.
approachIds: BNA roads used for forward and reverse approaches.
coverage: Lengths include repeated plan geometry. comparedMeters and disagreeMeters compare BNA and Utah on dual-matched portions.
